question: According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, properly performed HVAC system cleaning services should: A. eliminate all contamination. B. restore the internal insulation to an “as new” condition. C. restore the evaporator coil to its original pressure drop. D. render the system visibly clean.

Dirt streaks around supply diffusers that are NOT caused by a dirty ventilation system are MOST likely caused by: A. Slow discharge velocities. B. elevated relative humidity. C. dirty room air at the diffuser. D. thermal stratification around the diffuser.

According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, which of the following is the PRIMARY purpose of a written work plan? A. Minimizes potential for legal action against the contractor B. Allows a clear understanding of what work will be performed C. Ensures compliance with current Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations D. Documents the complete list of materials to be used on the job site

A package unit contains which of the following components? A. Compressor, evaporator coil, condenser, supply fan, and filter B. Evaporator coil, VAV box, condenser, supply fan, exhaust fan, and filter C. Compressor, hat water coil, condenser, supply fan, exhaust fan, and filter D. Compressor, evaporator coil, condenser, supply fan, thermostat, and filter

The MOST common types of fuel consumed in modern residential HVAC systems are: A. natural gas, propane, and oil B. electric, propane, and oil C. natural gas, methane, and oil D. natural gas, propane, and ethanol
What type of supply fan transfers large volumes of air with a minimal wheel diameter? A. Backward-inclined fan B. Forward-curved fan C. Axial fan D. Radial fan
In what sequence is an HVAC system typically cleaned? A. Supply, air handler, return B. Exhaust, air handler, return, supply C. Return, supply, exhaust, air handler D. Return, air handler, supply
When a properly wired condensate pump fails, it will: A. turn off the HVAC system. B. allow bypass of the condensate. C. maintain HVAC system airflow. D. engage dehumidification cycle.

What is the MOST effective way for an ASCS to test the function of a condensate pump? A. Unplug and plug in the pump B. Fill the condensate pan with clean water C. Disconnect the condensate drain line D. Fill the pump with clean water
Which of the following HVAC components controls the room air by regulating hot and cold air? A. VAV box B. Mixing box C. Attenuator D. Constant volume damper

Which of the following represents the static pressure, for each area listed, that is MOST likely to be found in a typical HVAC system? Supply Return Outside Air Ductwork Ductwork Intake A. Negative Positive Negative B. Positive Positive Negative C. Positive Negative Positive D. Positive Negative Negative
Changes in temperature in a constant air volume (CAV) system are made by: A. dampering at terminal ends. B. modulating the volume of air. C. heating or cooling the air. D. dampering at the fan.

According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, prior to Type 2 Coil Cleaning, the condensate pan and drain should be: A. plugged to prevent leakage. B. verified for proper drainage. C. HEPA vacuumed. D. compressed air washed.
If a condensate pan is full of water, what should the ASCS check FIRST? A. Coil leakage B. Pan slope C. Plenum pressure D. Drain line
Which component can be found in a fan coil unit? A. Condensate pan B. Humidifier C. Turning vane D. Diffuser
What is the equivalent MERV rating for HEPA filters? A. MERV 1–4 B. MERV 5–8 C. MERV 9–12 D. MERV 17–20

A commercial Air Handling Unit (AHU) generally consists of: A. supply fan, coil, filters, and outlet and inlet dampers. B. exhaust fan, coil, filters, and outlet and inlet dampers. C. supply fan, coil filters, and humidifier. D. exhaust fan, coil, filters, and humidifier.

During routine inspections where no local problem is discovered, an inspector shall inspect at least: A. 5% of similar systems. B. 10% of similar systems. C. 15% of similar systems. D. 20% of similar systems.

When conducting an inspection of an HVAC system with a spray humidifier installed, what should the ASCS look for? A. The angle of the spray nozzles B. The size of the spray nozzles C. Excessive dust accumulation D. Evidence of excessive moisture

According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, if when conducting a pre-cleaning inspection the Air Handling Unit (AHU) reveals suspect microbial growth, the ASCS shall: A. immediately put on a respirator and inform the occupants. B. stop the inspection and recommend a complete system cleaning. C. inspect the supply and return ducts as part of the inspection. D. close up the system to prevent any cross-contamination.
According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, what is the recommended inspection schedule for a residential supply duct? A. Every 6 months B. Every year C. Every 2 years D. Every 4 years
Transite (asbestos) pipe is often found in which type of HVAC systems? A. Dual duct system B. Sub-slab system C. Constant volume system D. Variable air system

According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, it is recommended that the work plan include the name and contact information for: A. the manufacturer of all equipment to be used on the project. B. contractors and representatives involved in the project. C. all employees working on the project. D. past projects conducted by the company.
According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, Cleaning of coils with steam is described as: A. Type 1. B. Method 1. C. Type 2. D. Method 2.
When cutting into fibrous glass duct board, which hand tool is MOST effective? A. Jigsaw B. Snips C. Nibbler D. Straight knife
Which pneumatic tool is often used to move debris into collection equipment? A. Whip B. Nibbler C. Shear D. Grinder

An inappropriate method for cleaning an electric reheat coil within a metal duct is: A. applying low pressure air. B. contact vacuuming. C. applying high pressure air. D. applying high pressure water.
Which method of cleaning, along with negative pressure, shall be used to remove particulate from ductwork? A. Agitation B. Fogging C. Ozonation D. Coating
Of the following, which is the MOST aggressive agitation tool available for cleaning HVAC systems? A. Air compressor B. Robot with camera C. Metal brush D. Skipper
A mechanical means of agitation which an ASCS can use to clean ductwork is: A. compressed air needle gun. B. compressed air washing. C. water blasting. D. sand blasting.

Which two factors should be considered to determine the type of air washing equipment to be used? A. Source of power and consumption. B. Type of debris and surface material. C. Type of tool and pressure requirement. D. Source of air and cubic feet per minute (CFM) output.
Which of the following materials used in zoning may result in the MOST cross-contamination from the previous day's work? A. Plastic B. Cardboard C. Metal D. Foam
Which ceiling type is easiest to remove for ductwork access? A. Tin B. Suspended C. Spline D. Sheet Rock

What does ACR, The NADCA Standard recommend while cleaning internally-lined fiberglass ductwork, microbial contamination is observed within the fiberglass liner? A. Remove and replace the fiberglass liner B. Clean and sanitize the fiberglass liner C. Clean and coat the fiberglass liner D. Clean and disinfect the fiberglass liner
During cleaning, vacuum collection equipment shall be used A. continuously. B. on the return only. C. on the supply only. D. when the building is occupied.

The NADCA Vacuum Test template is A. not necessary if the area being tested is well defined. B. made up of one 2x 25 cm slot C. used to prevent direct contact with the component surface. D. usually left in place for future testing of the same area

After completion of an air duct cleaning and visual inspection, the client states, "I expected the ducts to be cleaner.” What is the next step an ASCS should recommend? A. Re-cleaning of the entire system B. A Surface Comparison Test C. Re-cleaning of the affected area D. A NADCA Vacuum Test
Service openings shall NOT be made in what type of duct? A. Duct board B. Fibrous glass C. Metal D. Flexible

When finishing up the air duct cleaning project, what is one of the final steps the ASCS should perform prior to leaving the client's property? A. Check the panel to make certain the circuit breaker is of. B. Ensure fire protection systems are de-energized C. Check that the system functions property in heating/cooling mode. D. Ensure Lockout/Tagout locks are in place

When is it appropriate to verify the effectiveness of HVAC system cleaning? A. During the cleaning process B. After the system is cleaned, and before the system is restarted C. After the system is restarted D. After the system is cleaned, but before coil cleaning is completed

Unless otherwise specified, the goal of HVAC system cleaning is to restore the system to what minimum level of cleanliness? A. The system is visibly clean B. The system is tree of all adhered substances. C. The weight of contaminants is more than .7 mg per 100 sq. cm. D. The system passes the White Glove Test.
What is a common method of recording conditions inside the ductwork? A. A voice recording B. Written documentation C. Photographs D. Telling a coworker
Which color is the HEPA cartridge for a respirator? A. Blue B. Magenta C. Black D. Green
A magenta, or purple, color code on a respirator cartridge indicates which of the following types of filters? A. Carbon B. Organic C. HEPA D. Ultra Low Penetration Air (ULPA)

According to The NADCA White Paper on Using Chemical Products in HVAC Systems, The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has not registered any product for use as a disinfectant, sanitizer, or fungicide in the A. equipment room B. air handler C. exhaust fan D. ductwork
A balometer (flow hood) is MOST frequently used by which of the following trade persons? A. Architect B. Industrial hygienist C. Filtration specialist D. Test and balance specialist

During a water damage restoration, the Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC) Standard S500 states HVAC systems should A. not be cleaned B. Be operated in “fan on” mode C. not be used for dehumidification D. be used for dehumidification

HVAC system components subjected to flooding shall be evaluated and categorized according to which industry standard? A. Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC) S520 B. IICRC S500 C. National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 96 D. NFPA 90A
According to ACR, The NADCA Standard, mold remediation should be conducted in accordance with which standard? A. IICRC S500 B. IICRC S520 C. ASHRAE S180 D. NAIMA AH122
